hostPorts.purpose: Stores Catalog-owned provider asset bytes and returns public URLs for Source Observation promotion.
Emits bounded Catalog Integration Control Plane telemetry for provider option queries, integration jobs, and bulk review work units.

blueprints.purpose: Own blueprints feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the catalog context.
blueprints.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

catalog-items.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

fields.purpose: Own fields feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the catalog context.
fields.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

display-templates.purpose: Own Catalog display title and subtitle template policy, resolution metadata, and authoring APIs.
display-templates.allowedWhen: Required when Catalog display identity must be generated from Fields, Reference Records, Categories, Blueprints, and scoped overrides instead of repeated item strings.

product-measures.purpose: Own reusable product-measure-profile rules, item/product measurement overrides, and resolved product measure read models for shipping-aware downstream contexts.
product-measures.allowedWhen: Required when Catalog product truth must include physical measurement facts for shipping quotes and fulfillment package planning.

source-observations.purpose: Own provider source observations, review workflow, and promotion into canonical Catalog Items.
source-observations.allowedWhen: Required when external catalog providers can feed candidate Catalog facts.

reference-data.purpose: Own reference types and reference records that attach rich reusable facts to catalog item field values.
reference-data.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

authoring-support.purpose: Provide reusable authoring-support assets shared by catalog-owned features and composition seams.
authoring-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
authoring-support.justification: authoring-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
authoring-support.createdFor: catalog workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
authoring-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

realtime-support.purpose: Provide Catalog-owned realtime topic contracts and projection patch factories for admin projection refresh.
realtime-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only for Catalog-owned SSE projection patch routing and topic construction that spans multiple admin slices.
realtime-support.justification: realtime-support keeps Catalog admin topic ownership in the Catalog bounded context instead of deployables.
realtime-support.createdFor: SSE projection refresh on Catalog admin list surfaces.
realtime-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when Catalog no longer publishes or consumes realtime projection patches.

route-support.purpose: Provide the admin integrations route adapter modules (loader, action, form values, and command context) that orchestrate Catalog source observation workflows for the admin route.
route-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when route-layer behavior cannot stay inside the thin route module or a feature folder.
route-support.justification: route-support centralizes the admin integrations route's loader/action orchestration without mixing route adapter behavior into shell support.
route-support.createdFor: the catalog admin integrations route, which composes source observation workflows during loader and action handling.
route-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when the admin integrations route no longer needs extracted loader/action modules.
